svg.title: MarkeTech real time: the path of a signal, from Lea to Marc
svg.desc: Panel A, opening the line: when Marc is logged in, AppSidebar.vue calls followLive with his id and frontend/src/live.ts opens a WebSocket to wss://<host>/ws/. It passes the reverse proxy of the server and the Nginx of the frontend container (detail in infra-compose-stack.svg, panel C) and reaches Daphne, which calls config/asgi.py: ProtocolTypeRouter sends a WebSocket through AllowedHostsOriginValidator and AuthMiddlewareStack to live/routing.py, path ws/. LiveConsumer refuses an anonymous visitor, adds the channel of the tab to the group user_7 of the channel layer, then accepts; the line stays open. Panel B, a message and its signal: Lea posts "Hello" to /api/applications/12/messages/ through the same proxies; the view of messaging saves the message and calls live.news(application, live.MESSAGES), which on commit sends group_send to the groups of both people with type news, kind messages, application 12. In production the channel layer is RedisChannelLayer on a Redis container that keeps nothing on disk; in development it is InMemoryChannelLayer. The consumer of each open tab of Marc sends {"type": "messages", "application": 12} down the open WebSocket, through the proxies, to his browser. live.ts tells its onNews listeners; ConversationPage.vue reloads the conversation by GET through the API, which alone decides what Marc may see. Reading marks the message read and sends a second signal to both people. Panel C, who does what: Daphne, the view, LiveConsumer, the channel layer, Redis and live.ts in short notes. No polling: the signal leaves as soon as the message is saved. Legend: HTTP is a solid blue line, WebSocket an orange dashed line, the channel layer a pink dotted line.
svg.text: MarkeTech real time: the path of a signal, from Lea to Marc
Lea (candidate) writes in application 12 while Marc (employer, user 7) has its conversation open: how his page
learns it without asking. No polling: the signal leaves as soon as the message is saved. Follow the numbers 1 to 12.
Real files of the repository: backend/config/asgi.py, backend/live/, backend/messaging/views.py, backend/config/settings/,
docker-compose.yml, frontend/src/live.ts, notifications.ts, AppSidebar.vue, ConversationPage.vue, nginx.conf, vite.config.ts.
backend/live · settings dev.py and prod.py · live.ts

One process on port 8000 for HTTP and
WebSocket. It keeps each WebSocket open;
The view decides, the signal points
A signal says a kind and an application,
never the data: the page reads again
through the API, which checks the rights.
A failure to send is written to the log:
Refuses a visitor, joins user_<id>, then
passes on each signal of the group.
Whatever the browser sends is ignored.
Channel layer, a mailbox by group
Views and consumers never meet: a view
posts to a group, each tab in it receives.
5 s at a time for a signal, and the redis
client would give up a read after 5 s.
No snapshot, no journal: a restart loses
only signals, which live.ts makes up for.
A cut line opens again by itself after
1 s, then 2, 4 ... up to 30 s. At each
opening, and when the tab comes back to
the front, the listeners hear null and
